verdict.rationale: Logseq's official Export docs say a whole graph can be exported to JSON, standard Markdown, OPML, HTML, EDN and Roam JSON, and community users confirm local data they back up and sync via GitHub. That satisfies the 'stored or exportable' core of the story. However, users report that Logseq's generated Markdown has spacing quirks that break compatibility with tools like Obsidian, and the new DB version moves storage away from plain Markdown files. Missing for 10: published specs or schema docs for the exported formats, evidence that exported Markdown imports cleanly into other tools, and clarity on whether the DB version keeps open on-disk storage.
